questions.question: How long does a station last on batteries when it measures every ten minutes?

Since firmware 2.3.0 the units send data every 3 minutes, not every 10, so the test may not match current behaviour [3]. I found no measured real-world runtime at a 10-minute interval, so a field check would be the reliable answer.

questions.question: What caused the cloud outage according to the post-mortem?
questions.reference: The MQTT broker's TLS certificate expired (3 h 40 min down).
questions.answer: According to the post-mortem, the cloud outage was caused by the TLS certificate of the MQTT broker expiring. The renewal was a manual step that nobody owned. The outage lasted 3 h 40 min, and no data was lost because the stations buffered it [file:19ef833b-e0c9-4b44-8497-a8c2f1247120]. The fix is that cert-manager now renews the certificate automatically, and an alert fires 14 days before expiry.
